description: Track your reading list: to-read, reading with progress, and finished books.

faqs.a: Add a title (and optional author), then set its status. Use the progress slider for books you are currently reading.
faqs.q: How do I add a book?

faqs.a: The three status lanes are To Read, Reading, and Finished. You can change a book's status any time.
The number is the percentage of the book you have read — just your own estimate.
Yes, stored in this browser's localStorage. It stays private on this device.

howto: Enter the book title and author, pick a status, and click Add Book.
Move books between lists by changing status on each card.
Adjust the progress % slider for books you are reading.
Delete books you no longer want to track.
title: Reading List
